instruction: For a registry-based asset-matching review of CVE-2023-28771, list the firmware releases actually enumerated by the vulnerability catalogue's CPE applicability records together with the hardware required for each firmware product. Cover the complete configuration set for this CVE and the registered CPE Names matched by its criteria. Preserve the recorded alternatives and joint requirements: a firmware entry alone must not stand in for a complete applicable asset combination. This is an inventory of recorded matches, not a list of every release in a numerical version interval or a determination that an unlisted asset is safe. Use CPE product tokens for the hardware and firmware. In each registered release retain both the CPE version and update tokens, including literal * and -; do not expand a wildcard into hypothetical updates. Group together alternative registered releases for the same hardware/firmware product pair. Public APIs and equivalent bulk sources are allowed.
output_format: Return only a pipe-separated table with header hardware_product|firmware_product|registered_releases. Use one row per required hardware/firmware product pair, sorted lexicographically by hardware_product and then firmware_product. In registered_releases, use VERSION(UPDATE) tokens separated by semicolons, with duplicates removed and tokens sorted lexicographically. Report only explicitly matched CPE names; if a criterion has an explicitly empty match list, it contributes no enumerated release. Do not infer safety from an empty or absent registration.
